svg.text: END-TO-END FLOOD FORECASTING & ANTICIPATORY ACTION PIPELINE
Operational Multi-Head GBDT Engine (Task A) ⟶ Area-Preserving ~232 m Downscaler (Task B) ⟶ Multi-Asset Exposure Action

g.text: 1. DATA INGESTION & EMBARGO
STRICT FRIDAY 00:00 UTC OPERATIONAL EMBARGO
Zero lookahead leakage; mirrors humanitarian anticipatory cycle
Upstream Hydrometeorology (ERA5-Land)
• Catchment Runoff (Q_upstream): 1, 7, 14, 30-day cumulative lags
• Net Water Balance: P - ET₀ surplus balance
• Spatial Catchment: ~300 km Congo-Nile divide transit
Key Signal: Runoff accumulation drives downstream floodplain ponding
Remote Water Levels & River Gauges
• River Lol Gauges: gauge_w1, w7, w14 & 7-day stage rate-of-change
• Lake Albert & Sudd Altimetry remote water level monitoring
• Hydraulic routing delay delivers 2 to 4 weeks of actionable lead time
Physical Mechanism: Flat River Lol floodplain slows flood transit
Historical Satellite Baseline (MODIS)
• 26-Year Historical Inundation Record (2000–2025 Terra/Aqua)
• Native ~232 m Spatial Resolution (MODIS 8-day composites)
• Establishes empirical pixel climatology & permanent water masks
High Spatial Fidelity: Resolves localized drainage channels
2. MULTI-HEAD GBDT ENGINE (LIGHTGBM)
Feature Ingestion & Autoregression
Hydrometeorological Lags + Harmonic Seasonality (sin/cos) + Autoregressive Extent (y_lag1, y_lag2)
Weekly county tabular state: 1,810 pooled observation weeks across 5 Aweil counties
Head 1: Flood Detection Classifier [P(flood > 0)]
• Objective: Binary Cross-Entropy / LogLoss
• High Reliability: Brier Score = 0.0766 | BSS vs Climatology = +24.6%
Discriminates wet vs. dry weeks prior to extent quantification
Head 2: Tabular County Extent Quantiles [q10, q50, q90 km²]
• Objective: Asymmetric Pinball Loss (Quantile Regression)
• Calibrated Uncertainty Bounds: q10 (conservative) to q90 (extreme surge)
Central Forecast: Median q50 (km²) feeds area-conserving spatial downscaler
Head 3: Flood Persistence / Duration [h1, h2, h3, h4 weeks]
• Multi-Horizon Survival Heads: 1, 2, 3, and 4 weeks forward survival
• Beats Persistence: Markov persistence collapses by W3 (-6.8%), GBDT holds +26% BSS
Essential for prolonged standing water risk (crop rotting & livestock diseases)
Optuna Bayesian Hyperparameter Optimization
50+ TPE trials across learning rate, num_leaves, and L1/L2 alpha/lambda regularization.
Discovery: Objective loss rapidly saturates at ~0.366 (noise floor); further architectural
complexity cannot overcome irreducible observational variance.
3. DOWNSCALING & EXPOSURE
Area-Preserving Spatial Downscaling (Task B)
• Step 1: Ingest tabular county median extent q50 (km²)
• Step 2: Sample conditional pixel climatology P(pixel | month, county)
• Step 3: Discrete rank-order step merge: k = round(v / step - 0.5)
• Exact Mathematical Area Conservation: Σ sev_p × A_p ≡ q50
Mathematical Area Distortion: Δ = 0.000 km² (100% Exact Conservation)
Output: Calibrated ~232 m resolution inundation severity raster [sev ∈ (0, 1)]
[CROPLAND EXPOSURE] Stationary Food Security
• ASAP High-Resolution Cropland Mask (Sorghum & Groundnuts)
• Critical Collision: Ripening & Harvest season (Sep–Nov) vs. flood peak
• Stationary Vulnerability: Standing water >48h leads to 100% crop spoilage
• Anticipatory Trigger (2–3 wk lead): Emergency early harvesting,
drainage embankment clearing, & elevated grain bag storage
[CATTLE EXPOSURE] Mobile Pastoral Livestock
• GeoNode Livestock Density Layer (Dinka transhumance herds)
• River basin grazing corridors cut off by backwater flooding
• Mobile Vulnerability: Herds can relocate if dry routes are identified
• Anticipatory Trigger (7–14 d lead): Prophylactic liver-fluke dosing,
coordinated dry transhumance passage, & intercommunal peace pacts
